name: ProBench
description: ProBench is a benchmark of open-ended user queries requiring professional expertise and advanced reasoning across 10 fields and 56 sub-fields, including science, arts, humanities, coding, mathematics, and creative writing. It evaluates multimodal large language models on expert-level multimodal tasks involving visual perception, textual understanding, domain knowledge, and advanced reasoning.
reputation: A recent multimodal expert-level benchmark that is useful for evaluating professional reasoning across many fields, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Consists of 4,000 samples from professionals across 10 fields; evaluates advanced reasoning and multimodal understanding.
